Placemaker.Recipe.Amphitheatre.Descripti: Open-air venue: seating stepped into the terrain in an arc facing a stage, aisles, a top promenade — or an open-air cinema, a bandstand lawn, a concert meadow, a speakers' corner.
Placemaker.Amphitheatre.Name: Amphitheatre
Placemaker.Amphitheatre.style.Tooltip: Changes the extras: statues by the stage, a projection booth, string lights round a bandstand, a crowd barrier and mixing tent at a concert.
Placemaker.Amphitheatre.rows.Tooltip: Rows of seats on a site of 0.6 ha. A bigger site gets more rows (up to twice as many, on gentler steps), so the bowl fills it.
Placemaker.Amphitheatre.span.Tooltip: How far the seating wraps round the stage. 360° puts the stage in the middle.
Placemaker.Amphitheatre.terrain.Tooltip: Dig: the stage sits in a pit and the rows step back up to the ground. Build: the rows are raised towards a crest. Slope: keep the ground (the stage goes to the low side). None: flat.
Placemaker.Amphitheatre.rowDepth.Tooltip: Depth of one row (tread) from front to back.
Placemaker.Amphitheatre.rise.Tooltip: Height step from one row to the next.
Placemaker.Amphitheatre.seats.Tooltip: What stands on the rows: benches, deckchairs, picnic tables, or bare lawn steps.
Placemaker.Amphitheatre.aisles.Tooltip: Paths climbing the rows from the stage to the promenade.
Placemaker.Amphitheatre.rowShape.Tooltip: Curved rows round the stage, or straight rows facing a screen.
Placemaker.Amphitheatre.stageSize.Toolti: Radius of the stage area; the first row starts 2 m behind it.
Placemaker.Amphitheatre.stageSide.Toolti: Auto: the low side on a slope, else away from the road. Road: by the road. Far: away from the road. Low: lowest point. Centre: in the middle.
Placemaker.Amphitheatre.orchestra.Toolti: A paved floor round the stage in front of the first row.
Placemaker.Amphitheatre.backdrop.Tooltip: An arc of trees behind the stage.
Placemaker.Amphitheatre.promenade.Toolti: A path along the top of the seating, with side paths down to the stage.
Placemaker.Amphitheatre.kiosks.Tooltip: Refreshment kiosks behind the promenade (food trucks at a concert meadow).
Placemaker.Amphitheatre.lightTowers.Tool: Light towers at the front corners and behind the seating.
Placemaker.Amphitheatre.Issue.NoRoom: No room for even one row of seating — a stage on a lawn instead.
